final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(CASE WHEN b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 AND b.spent IS NOT NULL THEN b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount END) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_mean FROM per_type
